# Sentify

> Free, ad-free music streaming web player with mood-based discovery, synced lyrics, smart queues, and full-length playback.

Sentify is a web-based music player focused on a clean, ad-free listening experience. It supports mood-based discovery, instant search across songs and artists, synced lyrics with translation, offline downloads, and a personal library.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Mood-based discovery and featured music.
- [Search](/search): Instant search for songs, artists, and albums.
- [Library](/library): Liked songs, favorite artists, playlists, and search history.
- [Downloads](/downloads): Offline music downloads and playback.
- [Sign In](/auth): Account sign-in and password reset.

## Optional

- [Reset Password](/reset-password): Secure password reset flow.
